Correction Feedback

Dr Pinny Clifton
Department of Cardiothoracic surgery
Central Hospital
Main Street
Stillwater

22/08/2015

Dear Dr Clifton,

RE: Mrs Mary Clarke

I am writing to refer Mrs Clarke, a 45-year-old office clerk, whose recent x-ray and CT scans are
suggestive of bronchogenic carcinoma. Please note, follow up investigations, including a
bronchoscopic biopsy, and assessment are required.                                                   Commented [OET1]: try to use more polite style


Mrs Clarke has been a smoker for more than 30 years and smokes 30-35 cigarettes per day. In          Commented [OET2]: 30 to 35
terms of her family history, her mother died of laryngeal carcinoma at the age of 66.

Today, Mrs Clarke presented at the clinic with a 7-week history of a dry non-productive cough with
no haemoptysis. Her cough commenced with flu-like symptoms, which were cleared with
Augmentin 6 weeks previously. She reported having mild shortness of breath, especially at night,
along with a strange sensation of heaviness in her chest. However, her exercise tolerance was
good. To explain, she was able to perform her daily activities.

Mrs Clarke’s respiratory examination revealed signs of consolidation associated with a monophonic
wheeze in the middle zone of the right lung. The remainder of the examination was unremarkable.
Besides that, the x-ray and CT scans of the chest showed atelectasis of the right middle lobe
together with an enlarged right hilum.

Based on the above information, Mrs Clarke was counselled on the potential diagnosis and the
need for further investigations. If you have any queries, please contact me.


Yours sincerely,
Doctor

   2. A comma is not required with dependent clauses e.g. “Vegetarians are people who do not
